errors.text_span: eine violette Linie, die von 1995 nahe 0 über die 2000er Jahre auf etwa 0,5 ansteigt, um 2009/2010 auf etwa 1,0 zu steigen und danach weiter bis etwa 1,5 um 2014/2015 zu wachsen, mit einem späteren deutlichen Anstieg bis nahe 2,0 um 2019/2020
errors.evidence: The left diagram contains a red line, not a violet/purple line. The machine-generated description incorrectly assigns the color violet/purple to the line that is actually red.

errors.text_span: um 2018/2019 auf Werte nahe 0,2 abzufallen, bevor sie 2020 wieder auf etwa 0,5 ansteigt
errors.evidence: The blue line in the left diagram does not fall to near 0.2; it falls to approximately 0.5 in 2020. The description incorrectly reports a value near 0.2.
The left y-axis in the right diagram ranges from -5 to 2, not -0.5 to 2.0. The description incorrectly reports the scale.
The triangles in the left diagram are red, not reddish/magenta. The description incorrectly assigns the color.
The blue line in the right diagram is slightly above 0 in 2001, not near 0. The description slightly misrepresents the value.
The machine-generated description omits the red line in the right diagram, which starts at about 35 in 1995 and rises to around 67 in 2020.
The machine-generated description does not mention the red triangles in the right diagram, which follow a similar trend to the red line.

The machine-generated description omits the exact tick intervals for the right y-axis in the right diagram (Schuldenquote Zentralstaat), which are 30 to 70 with intervals of 10, though it mentions the range.
The lines in both diagrams have markers (triangles for the debt quota data points). The description incorrectly states that the lines are without markers.
The machine-generated description does not state the purpose of the charts, which is to show the relationship between the IMF fiscal index and debt ratios for the overall state and central state.
